section.title: Edit Models
section.p: pmMDA UML models can be edited either using the provided user interface or more conveniently UML modeling tools such as ArgoUML or Poseidon. Both tools support all UML diagrams and allow the definition of stereotypes, datatypes and tagged values.

MDA approaches require more formal UML models to allow model transformations and source code artifacts generation. Here we provide some hints which conventions should be followed in UML models transformed with pmMDA.

The naming conventions should follow best practices of UML. Class and interface names starts with uppercase. Property names always start with lowercase. All names should be legal identifiers in the target programming language. The validator framework checks the corectness of identifiers, uppercase and lowercase.
The name of all UML entities should be formulated in English. The pmMDA engine currently only support grammar rules for English language.
The name of properties should be singular if their cardinality is limited to one and plural if multiple instances are possible.

All relashionships should be named. All relationships should be directed. Role names can be defined but are not currently used in the transformation. The validator framework checks that all relationships are named.

section.title: Configure pmMDA
section.p: The pmMDA provides two major levels of configuration. The properties file of the application configures overall aspects of the tool and register the cartridges which should be used. Each cartridge can add their own properties in this file. For a detailed discussion of the supported properties please read the comments in the properties file and the documentation of the cartridge you use.
section.note: The properties file of pmMDA supports recursive variable definition such as the one provided in Ant. You can structure your variables in a structured way to minimize customisation effort.
section.p: Each cartridge provides an xml configuration file to tailor the mapping of PIM elements such as datatypes to the coding conventions of your projects. The mapping file also provides mechanisms to declare unneeded tagged values as obsolete.

section.title: Links
section.p: UML concepts definition and description can be found in the official site of OMG. Please consult their web site OMG.
The UML modelization tool ArgoUML can be downloaded from their home page ArgoUML.
